# Virtuse — full rates and fees

As of Q3 2026. Copied from seo-build data / live Layer 2 modules. Do not treat as advice.

## Countries

### 🇨🇿 Czechia (`cz`)
- Gain tax: 15% income tax (23% above threshold)
- Exemption: Tax-free after a 3-year holding period (time test)
- Filing: Annual personal tax return
- Note: Every disposal (including crypto-to-crypto swaps) is a taxable event – keep complete records from day one.
- EN: https://virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/czechia/
- DE: https://virtuse.com/de/bitcoin-steuern/tschechien/
- SK: https://virtuse.com/sk/bitcoin-dane/cesko/
- CS: https://virtuse.com/cs/bitcoin-dane/cesko/
- PL: https://virtuse.com/pl/bitcoin-podatki/czechy/
- HU: https://virtuse.com/hu/bitcoin-adozas/csehorszag/
- UK: https://virtuse.com/uk/bitcoin-podatky/chekhiia/
- RU: https://virtuse.com/ru/bitcoin-nalogi/chekhiya/
- FR: https://virtuse.com/fr/bitcoin-fiscalite/tchequie/
- ES: https://virtuse.com/es/bitcoin-impuestos/republica-checa/

### 🇸🇰 Slovakia (`sk`)
- Gain tax: 19–35% income tax plus 16% health contributions
- Exemption: No holding-period exemption; every sale or crypto-to-crypto swap is taxed
- Filing: Annual personal tax return (type B), due 31 March
- Note: A 7% rate and a 1-year exemption were cancelled before taking effect. A net crypto loss cannot offset other income.
- EN: https://virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/slovakia/
- DE: https://virtuse.com/de/bitcoin-steuern/slowakei/
- SK: https://virtuse.com/sk/bitcoin-dane/slovensko/
- CS: https://virtuse.com/cs/bitcoin-dane/slovensko/
- PL: https://virtuse.com/pl/bitcoin-podatki/slowacja/
- HU: https://virtuse.com/hu/bitcoin-adozas/szlovakia/
- UK: https://virtuse.com/uk/bitcoin-podatky/slovachchyna/
- RU: https://virtuse.com/ru/bitcoin-nalogi/slovakiya/
- FR: https://virtuse.com/fr/bitcoin-fiscalite/slovaquie/
- ES: https://virtuse.com/es/bitcoin-impuestos/eslovaquia/

### 🇵🇱 Poland (`pl`)
- Gain tax: 19% flat capital gains tax
- Exemption: No holding-period exemption
- Filing: Annual PIT-38
- Note: Crypto-to-crypto swaps are not taxed – only sales for money, goods or services are. Calculate each sale’s PLN gain or loss.
- EN: https://virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/poland/
- DE: https://virtuse.com/de/bitcoin-steuern/polen/
- SK: https://virtuse.com/sk/bitcoin-dane/polsko/
- CS: https://virtuse.com/cs/bitcoin-dane/polsko/
- PL: https://virtuse.com/pl/bitcoin-podatki/polska/
- HU: https://virtuse.com/hu/bitcoin-adozas/lengyelorszag/
- UK: https://virtuse.com/uk/bitcoin-podatky/polshcha/
- RU: https://virtuse.com/ru/bitcoin-nalogi/polsha/
- FR: https://virtuse.com/fr/bitcoin-fiscalite/pologne/
- ES: https://virtuse.com/es/bitcoin-impuestos/polonia/

### 🇦🇹 Austria (`at`)
- Gain tax: 27.5% KESt (capital gains tax)
- Exemption: Tax-free after 1 year only for crypto bought before March 2021; later purchases have no exemption
- Filing: Annual return for gains via foreign exchanges; Austrian providers withhold the tax
- Note: Crypto-to-crypto swaps are tax-neutral. Lending and mining are taxed on receipt; staking rewards and airdrops are taxed when sold, at zero cost.
- EN: https://virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/austria/
- DE: https://virtuse.com/de/bitcoin-steuern/oesterreich/
- SK: https://virtuse.com/sk/bitcoin-dane/rakusko/
- CS: https://virtuse.com/cs/bitcoin-dane/rakousko/
- PL: https://virtuse.com/pl/bitcoin-podatki/austria/
- HU: https://virtuse.com/hu/bitcoin-adozas/ausztria/
- UK: https://virtuse.com/uk/bitcoin-podatky/avstriia/
- RU: https://virtuse.com/ru/bitcoin-nalogi/avstriya/
- FR: https://virtuse.com/fr/bitcoin-fiscalite/autriche/
- ES: https://virtuse.com/es/bitcoin-impuestos/austria/

### 🇩🇪 Germany (`de`)
- Gain tax: Up to 45% income tax (progressive)
- Exemption: 0% after a 1-year holding period (private-sale exemption)
- Filing: Annual tax return
- Note: Crypto-to-crypto swaps are taxable within the first year. FIFO record-keeping is critical.
- EN: https://virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/germany/
- DE: https://virtuse.com/de/bitcoin-steuern/deutschland/
- SK: https://virtuse.com/sk/bitcoin-dane/nemecko/
- CS: https://virtuse.com/cs/bitcoin-dane/nemecko/
- PL: https://virtuse.com/pl/bitcoin-podatki/niemcy/
- HU: https://virtuse.com/hu/bitcoin-adozas/nemetorszag/
- UK: https://virtuse.com/uk/bitcoin-podatky/nimechchyna/
- RU: https://virtuse.com/ru/bitcoin-nalogi/germaniya/
- FR: https://virtuse.com/fr/bitcoin-fiscalite/allemagne/
- ES: https://virtuse.com/es/bitcoin-impuestos/alemania/

### 🇭🇺 Hungary (`hu`)
- Gain tax: 15% capital gains tax
- Exemption: No holding-period exemption
- Filing: Annual personal income tax return
- Note: Documented acquisition costs are deductible – keep every invoice.
- EN: https://virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/hungary/
- DE: https://virtuse.com/de/bitcoin-steuern/ungarn/
- SK: https://virtuse.com/sk/bitcoin-dane/madarsko/
- CS: https://virtuse.com/cs/bitcoin-dane/madarsko/
- PL: https://virtuse.com/pl/bitcoin-podatki/wegry/
- HU: https://virtuse.com/hu/bitcoin-adozas/magyarorszag/
- UK: https://virtuse.com/uk/bitcoin-podatky/uhorshchyna/
- RU: https://virtuse.com/ru/bitcoin-nalogi/vengriya/
- FR: https://virtuse.com/fr/bitcoin-fiscalite/hongrie/
- ES: https://virtuse.com/es/bitcoin-impuestos/hungria/

### 🇸🇮 Slovenia (`si`)
- Gain tax: No tax on private disposal gains (business trading is taxed)
- Exemption: Private gains are not taxed; a proposed 25% tax was withdrawn in 2025
- Filing: None for private gains; business and mining income in the annual return
- Note: Mining is taxed as other income. Frequent trading can count as a business activity.
- EN: https://virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/slovenia/
- DE: https://virtuse.com/de/bitcoin-steuern/slowenien/
- SK: https://virtuse.com/sk/bitcoin-dane/slovinsko/
- CS: https://virtuse.com/cs/bitcoin-dane/slovinsko/
- PL: https://virtuse.com/pl/bitcoin-podatki/slowenia/
- HU: https://virtuse.com/hu/bitcoin-adozas/szlovenia/
- UK: https://virtuse.com/uk/bitcoin-podatky/sloveniia/
- RU: https://virtuse.com/ru/bitcoin-nalogi/sloveniya/
- FR: https://virtuse.com/fr/bitcoin-fiscalite/slovenie/
- ES: https://virtuse.com/es/bitcoin-impuestos/eslovenia/

### 🇭🇷 Croatia (`hr`)
- Gain tax: 12% on crypto gains (since 2024)
- Exemption: Tax-free after a 2-year holding period
- Filing: JOPPD form by the end of February (not the annual return)
- Note: File JOPPD even for exempt sales. Losses offset gains only within the same year.
- EN: https://virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/croatia/
- DE: https://virtuse.com/de/bitcoin-steuern/kroatien/
- SK: https://virtuse.com/sk/bitcoin-dane/chorvatsko/
- CS: https://virtuse.com/cs/bitcoin-dane/chorvatsko/
- PL: https://virtuse.com/pl/bitcoin-podatki/chorwacja/
- HU: https://virtuse.com/hu/bitcoin-adozas/horvatorszag/
- UK: https://virtuse.com/uk/bitcoin-podatky/khorvatiia/
- RU: https://virtuse.com/ru/bitcoin-nalogi/khorvatiya/
- FR: https://virtuse.com/fr/bitcoin-fiscalite/croatie/
- ES: https://virtuse.com/es/bitcoin-impuestos/croacia/

### 🇷🇴 Romania (`ro`)
- Gain tax: 16% income tax on crypto gains (10% until 2025)
- Exemption: No holding-period exemption
- Filing: Annual return (income from other sources)
- Note: The rate rose from 10% to 16% for gains from 2026. Gains under 200 lei per transaction are exempt up to 600 lei a year.
- EN: https://virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/romania/
- DE: https://virtuse.com/de/bitcoin-steuern/rumaenien/
- SK: https://virtuse.com/sk/bitcoin-dane/rumunsko/
- CS: https://virtuse.com/cs/bitcoin-dane/rumunsko/
- PL: https://virtuse.com/pl/bitcoin-podatki/rumunia/
- HU: https://virtuse.com/hu/bitcoin-adozas/romania/
- UK: https://virtuse.com/uk/bitcoin-podatky/rumuniia/
- RU: https://virtuse.com/ru/bitcoin-nalogi/rumyniya/
- FR: https://virtuse.com/fr/bitcoin-fiscalite/roumanie/
- ES: https://virtuse.com/es/bitcoin-impuestos/rumania/

### 🇧🇬 Bulgaria (`bg`)
- Gain tax: 10% flat tax on gains
- Exemption: No holding-period exemption
- Filing: Annual tax return
- Note: Low flat rate; keep exchange statements so your records are audit-ready.
- EN: https://virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/bulgaria/
- DE: https://virtuse.com/de/bitcoin-steuern/bulgarien/
- SK: https://virtuse.com/sk/bitcoin-dane/bulharsko/
- CS: https://virtuse.com/cs/bitcoin-dane/bulharsko/
- PL: https://virtuse.com/pl/bitcoin-podatki/bulgaria/
- HU: https://virtuse.com/hu/bitcoin-adozas/bulgaria/
- UK: https://virtuse.com/uk/bitcoin-podatky/bolhariia/
- RU: https://virtuse.com/ru/bitcoin-nalogi/bolgariya/
- FR: https://virtuse.com/fr/bitcoin-fiscalite/bulgarie/
- ES: https://virtuse.com/es/bitcoin-impuestos/bulgaria/

### 🇳🇱 Netherlands (`nl`)
- Gain tax: Box 3 wealth tax on a deemed return (about 36% of the assumed yield)
- Exemption: Tax-free allowance (€59,357 per person, 2026)
- Filing: Annual Box 3 declaration
- Note: No capital gains tax as such – you are taxed on an assumed return on your holdings. Box 3 is being reformed – check the current year’s rules.
- EN: https://virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/netherlands/
- DE: https://virtuse.com/de/bitcoin-steuern/niederlande/
- SK: https://virtuse.com/sk/bitcoin-dane/holandsko/
- CS: https://virtuse.com/cs/bitcoin-dane/nizozemsko/
- PL: https://virtuse.com/pl/bitcoin-podatki/holandia/
- HU: https://virtuse.com/hu/bitcoin-adozas/hollandia/
- UK: https://virtuse.com/uk/bitcoin-podatky/niderlandy/
- RU: https://virtuse.com/ru/bitcoin-nalogi/niderlandy/
- FR: https://virtuse.com/fr/bitcoin-fiscalite/pays-bas/
- ES: https://virtuse.com/es/bitcoin-impuestos/paises-bajos/

### 🇫🇷 France (`fr`)
- Gain tax: 31.4% flat tax (PFU: 12.8% income tax + 18.6% social charges, 2026)
- Exemption: No holding-period exemption; total disposals up to €305 a year are exempt
- Filing: Annual return with form 2086; foreign accounts on form 3916-bis
- Note: Crypto-to-crypto swaps are not taxed: only sales for euros, goods or services are.
- EN: https://virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/france/
- DE: https://virtuse.com/de/bitcoin-steuern/frankreich/
- SK: https://virtuse.com/sk/bitcoin-dane/francuzsko/
- CS: https://virtuse.com/cs/bitcoin-dane/francie/
- PL: https://virtuse.com/pl/bitcoin-podatki/francja/
- HU: https://virtuse.com/hu/bitcoin-adozas/franciaorszag/
- UK: https://virtuse.com/uk/bitcoin-podatky/frantsiia/
- RU: https://virtuse.com/ru/bitcoin-nalogi/frantsiya/
- FR: https://virtuse.com/fr/bitcoin-fiscalite/france/
- ES: https://virtuse.com/es/bitcoin-impuestos/francia/

### 🇪🇸 Spain (`es`)
- Gain tax: 19–30% progressive tax on savings income
- Exemption: No holding-period exemption
- Filing: Annual IRPF return; Modelo 721 for crypto held abroad over €50,000
- Note: Crypto-to-crypto swaps are taxable disposals – use FIFO for identical coins.
- EN: https://virtuse.com/bitcoin-tax/spain/
- DE: https://virtuse.com/de/bitcoin-steuern/spanien/
- SK: https://virtuse.com/sk/bitcoin-dane/spanielsko/
- CS: https://virtuse.com/cs/bitcoin-dane/spanelsko/
- PL: https://virtuse.com/pl/bitcoin-podatki/hiszpania/
- HU: https://virtuse.com/hu/bitcoin-adozas/spanyolorszag/
- UK: https://virtuse.com/uk/bitcoin-podatky/ispaniia/
- RU: https://virtuse.com/ru/bitcoin-nalogi/ispaniya/
- FR: https://virtuse.com/fr/bitcoin-fiscalite/espagne/
- ES: https://virtuse.com/es/bitcoin-impuestos/espana/


## Fee schedule (live stacking module)

- 21bitcoin | Auto-Invest plan | pct=0 | fixed=0 | monthly=0 | 0% fees on the built-in Auto-Invest savings plan from day 8 (the first 7 days carry the regular purchase fee) – FMA MiCAR-licensed, insured custody and already automated: set the schedule once and it runs itself.
- ByBit EU | Spot trading | pct=0.0025 | fixed=0 | monthly=0 | Spot taker fee 0.25% (0.1% maker) – EU-licensed in Vienna, with deep order books for manual recurring buys.
- Kraken | Pro trading | pct=0.008 | fixed=0 | monthly=0 | Kraken Pro taker fee 0.8% at the entry tier (0.4% maker; lower from $2.5K monthly volume) – a veteran EU exchange with deep EUR liquidity since 2011.

Formula: costPerPurchase = contribution * pct + fixed + monthly / (periodsPerYear / 12); annualDrag = costPerPurchase * periodsPerYear.

## Inheritance checklist (tax module)

- Do your heirs have written instructions (a "letter of instruction")? (20 pts): Write a letter of instruction: inventory, locations, contacts – never seed phrases. Store it with your will or attorney.
- Are your keys geographically separated? (20 pts): Move one key or backup to a second location: a bank vault, a trusted family member or a professional key agent.
- Does at least one heir know your bitcoin exists and where to start? (15 pts): Tell one trusted person that your bitcoin exists and whom to contact. Full details belong only in the letter of instruction.
- Do you use multisig (2-of-3) instead of a single seed phrase? (20 pts): Upgrade to 2-of-3 multisig: you hold two keys, and a partner (e.g. an Unchained-style vault) or an attorney holds the third.
- Have you tested recovery with a small amount? (15 pts): Do a full recovery drill on a small UTXO, with your heir watching, once a year.
- Are exchange accounts, loans and automated plans documented? (15 pts): Maintain an inventory of platforms, account IDs and how balances should be claimed – inside your letter of instruction.

- Indicative 2026 overview – not tax advice
- Virtuse never holds your keys
- KYC and onboarding are completed on each partner’s regulated platform
